answer: Shared nectar drip budgets cap sybil scale. Each verified operator gets one nectar drip that refills at 12 units per epoch, and every alias under that operator draws from the same drip, so spawning 100 aliases never creates 100 budgets. A job costs 3 units, and the wharf ledger records which drip paid for each job. A glacier audit traces overlapping draws back to one operator. Aliases that share a drip and submit identical job patterns within 2 epochs are flagged, the drip freezes for 14 epochs, and the frozen earnings burn.
